pos.personaBrief: Possession-based 'shoeshine and piano', 68% vs Fluminense, 65% vs AmaZulu, Cardoso imposes his style; possession is control, not just a means.

pro.personaBrief: Six players in low build-up against high-pressing Dortmund, back three with Mokoena dropping, one-touch combinations; Cardoso says he kept building under pressure in Portugal.

est.personaBrief: Rehearsed 4-2-3-1 morphing into 3-5-2 with defined phase structures, but pivots rotate and Zwane/Ribeiro drift into central spaces, mobile front line without strikers.

lar.personaBrief: High, wide full-backs and wingers pin the opponent; Cardoso fixed a narrow first half by using the width, yet Ribeiro cuts inside from the left and the game is built through central rotations.

blo.personaBrief: 4-1-4-1 with lateral pressure out of possession, counter-pressing noted, offside trap; not a deep block, and Cardoso rejects the 'defensive' label.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal marking at set pieces documented, slack marking criticised in the Pyramids tie; he did work to reduce Belaili's threat but no dedicated man-marking is documented.

pla.personaBrief: Insists on imposing his style ('by imposing our style we create our moments'), calls doubters wrong; only acknowledged less possession at the Club World Cup, and adjusts details at half-time.

res.personaBrief: Cardoso defends a proactive style and rejects being called defensive, but results matter in the title race and the CAF final; late changes came too late in the final.

sis.personaBrief: Collective system with defined roles and rotations; he benched the star Zwane in the CAF final and squad depth is rotated heavily, so the system outranks individuals.

jog.personaBrief: Technical, one-touch style with ball-playing pivots (Williams, Mokoena, Allende); playmaker Zwane valued, though pace of defenders was exposed by Pyramids.

bas.personaBrief: Squad of mostly experienced South Africans, bought-in foreigners; Cardoso says youngsters are part of long-term vision but not yet ready to be regulars.

lid.personaBrief: Popular with players but demanding: hard on players at half-time, dropped the captain Zwane from the final; decisions are his, rules apply to all.
